usedFor: Stape sets up gateways, and Google Docs records them when “New Singals Gateway” runs “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Singals Gateway” in Stape, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new gateway gets written into a doc tab, giving you a running reference for your setup.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s content, so point it at a tab you can overwrite.
